title: ML identifies autophagy-related genes as osteoarthritis diagnostic markers
summary: Integrating single-cell and bulk RNA data with 367 autophagy-related genes, 40 were found, and multiple machine-learning algorithms plus PPI networks selected DDIT3, JUN and VEGFA. A random forest model built on them predicted osteoarthritis in external validation datasets. Expression was examined in stressed osteoblasts and in human and mouse tissues, and explant-osteoblast co-culture supported a role in osteoarthritis.
ai_technology: Multiple machine-learning algorithms with PPI networks and a random forest diagnostic model
organization: Third Affiliated Hospital of Southern Medical University; Key Laboratory of Guangdong Province; Southern Medical University

evidence.tested: Gene expression was examined in osteoblasts under mechanical stress, human and mouse tissues, with co-culture experiments.

evidence.ai_role: ML algorithms selected three key genes from 40 candidates and a random forest built a diagnostic model.
